guide.head: How to play · {title}
guide.p1l1: A whole story is torn into dozens of pages: names and places left blank, the order scrambled.
guide.p1l2: Restore the names, restore the order, complete the dossiers, and answer the cloze at each chapter’s end.
guide.p1l3: The Story tab keeps openings you have seen, then the recap after you clear a volume. When every chapter is done, the story stands whole again.
guide.p2l1: In the lexicon, “Search” a term (1 vitality) to find a new page.
guide.p2l2: While reading, tap a tinted word to add it to the lexicon (familiarity +1).
guide.p2l3: Each page has blanks: choose the right people and places, then tap “Verify page”.
guide.p2l4: All correct: the page is complete, vitality +1. A miss does not cost vitality, but counts as an error.
guide.p3l1: New pages wait in the left column first; they are not mixed with those already placed.
guide.p3l2: Select a page, then a cell, to place, move, or swap.
guide.p3l3: When two neighbouring cells are relatively correct, a green line appears (before they lock).
guide.p3l4: A whole row or column locks only when every page in it is complete and correctly placed. Completing a page reveals its title and its picture in the cell.
guide.p3l5: Row names stay hidden as “Time N” until the row locks — or spend 1 vitality on “Hint” under the row head.
guide.p4l1: When familiarity is full, tap “Analyse” on the Dossier tab to open a file.
guide.p4l2: Fill the blanks on each file and gather every dossier for the chapter.
guide.p4l3: Placed pages (weight 25) plus completed dossiers (weight 10) must reach 70% before you may answer the cloze at the chapter exit.
guide.p4l4: At 100% you may “Auto-fill”: answers go into drafts only. You still tap “Check answers”. Stars are unaffected.
guide.p4l5: Stars start at three. Each filled quota of errors or rests costs one star, down to zero. Error caps 0/3 then /13; rest caps 0/5 then /15. Hints do not count.
guide.p4l6: When vitality is empty, “Rest” appears beside the number. If you are stuck, tap “Hint” in the top bar.
